summary: Not approved. Part 9 covers Jinshu 109 units s0092–s0110: Murong Huang’s 咸康七年 Longcheng move and Goguryeo/Wandu war, 明年 Gao Zhao submission with return of Li’s corpse, then undated Moqian Hun, farming, Yuwen Gui/Sheyiyu, Changli/Weide, victory feast, and park-oxen shares. Jinshu’s own year-words convert as 咸康七年→AD 341 and 明年→AD 342, but ZZTJ 卷097 spreads the same arc across 咸康八年 (342 move and Wandu), 建元元年 (343 submission and Moqian Hun), 建元二年 (344 Yuwen destruction and Sheyiyu’s death), and 永和元年 (345 park levy). Every owned point year and hint that collapses that arc is incorrect. Separately, claim-825/hints-p126 import a 300–331 Micheon reign for Li that the chapter never states—Li appears only as a corpse. No birth or age is stated in the owned units; the only death is Sheyiyu’s. This is not a full-chapter approval.
